_doc: pvscore 5.1 r2, text profile claims_v5: how combine.py / score51.py score a script item (M50_001..M50_016) with the v5 claims (text lead: tools/text_v5/claims_score.py + claims_core.py, rules text_items/drafts_v5/_build/PREREG_v5.json prereg_v5.0.1, mapping text_items/drafts_v5/SCORING_v5.md s2).

PRE-REGISTERED: written 2026-10-18T16:47:43Z by fork C, BEFORE any claims_v5 total was computed by 5.1 (the only v5 numbers seen are the text lead's GT self-tests in SCORING_v5.md / claims_score_selftest.json). Looked at: SCORING_v5.md, PREREG_v5.json, the claims files' structure (item, gt_item, prereg sha, claim counts), claims_score.py's API, the 5.0.11 report layout (A1 count rows). Not looked at: any model score under v5, data/v51_pilot/rank/. A change after a look goes to a new file.

Applies only where the cell's text profile is claims_v5 (a dataset mapped to it in the driver config, or the run flag --text-profile claims_v5, recorded in the output) and only to kind script. miniset50_v1 stays on layout_r2: its prompts state coordinates. Every other item kind and every dimension rule not named here is r2 (combine_weights_v51r2.json).

scoring_v5_section2.D1: as r2 (d1_gate A2 / B1 / B2, full_at 0.25)

A1.why: SCORING_v5 s3: the 5.0.x count items whose (space, class) group holds an omitted GT object are left out

A3.why: alone: one kept 5.0.x block in one slot -> N/A by the r2 activation rule (SCORING_v5 s2)

dropped_509.A2.objects: per-object item gated by position in the aligned GT frame (lin(d/L, 0.02, 0.10), ~0.2 m full credit) against video 3D GT with 1.2-4.4 m median error, and 0 without alignment; design §2.2/§6 replaces it with L1/L2/S facts. Its yaw/size/support terms are only reached through the position gate.
dropped_509.A2.occupancy: footprint F1 on a 10 cm grid in the aligned GT frame; same reason.
dropped_509.B1.shape: GT-frame Fréchet when aligned, half credit rigid-only otherwise (credit cap depends on alignment); replaced by R3 (route_direction stands in).
dropped_509.B1.endpoints: 0 without alignment (motion.py 'no alignment'); replaced by R1.
dropped_509.B1.waypoints: only when aligned; replaced by R1/R2.
dropped_509.B1.heading: item exists only when aligned, so its presence depends on the model; replaced by R5.
dropped_509.C1.position: d/L in the aligned GT frame, 0 without alignment; design §2.5 deletes it.
dropped_509.C1.direction: GT-frame view angle, pitch-only half credit without alignment; design §2.5 deletes it.
dropped_509.A1.zones: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): polygon in the aligned frame (none on these items)
dropped_509.A1.extras: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): all 16 GT items set extras = none
dropped_509.A2.relations: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): its near / distance types are metres; the v5 layout block takes the slot
dropped_509.A3.outline: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): aligned frame / metres
dropped_509.A3.openings: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): aligned frame / metres
dropped_509.B1.progress: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): path-length ratio compares metres
dropped_509.B2.relations_t: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): near / distance in metres; the timed relations the prompt states are v5 entity claims
dropped_509.C1.subject: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): distance ratio; cam_side is a v5 camera check
dropped_509.C1.fov: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): log hfov ratio; v5 cam_lens replaces it
dropped_509.C1.move: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): GT amounts; v5 cam_move replaces it
dropped_509.C1.spec: SCORING_v5 s2 (claims_v5 profile): pitch / azimuth classes not worded in the prompts

v5_rules.member: src v5 = the claims_score.py block of that name (layout | entity | camera): score = blocks[b].score, n = blocks[b].n (the item's registered claims / checks, fixed by the item), always informative
v5_rules.member_min_n_why: SCORING_v5 s2: a v5 block is present when the item registers >= 5 claims / checks (all v5 blocks of the 16 items are present: layout 9-43, entity 14-37, camera 27-63)
v5_rules.activation_why: SCORING_v5 s2: n is fixed by the item, so the r2 2-slot / 10-fact clause does not apply to a dimension with a used v5 member; it still applies to dimensions of 5.0.x blocks only (A3)
v5_rules.zero_not_na: a model that builds nothing gets the block score claims_score.py gives (coverage 0 -> 0), never N/A
v5_rules.new_layer: v5 members count as new-layer points (new_layer_points) like the view / facts3d members
v5_rules.a1_counts_drop: member option drop = a1_counts_drop: the 5.0.11 A1 counts block recomputed from the report's item rows (dim A1, block counts, weight > 0; weighted mean as pvscore5 items.dim_scores) without the rows named in claims_score.py a1_counts_drop; no row left -> member absent; a drop id that is not a report row is listed in the cell, nothing else
v5_rules.d1_gate: as r2 (content dims A2 / B1 / B2, full_at 0.25)

driver_rules.claims_file: the v5 claims file whose gt_item is the cell's item (bench: text_items/drafts_v5/claims/MS50_Txx.json; package: gt_pack/<item>/claims_v5.json, byte copy); none -> pending no_claims
driver_rules.prereg_check: claims prereg_sha256 must equal the sha256 of the PREREG_v5.json in use; otherwise pending claims_prereg_mismatch
driver_rules.gt: claims_score.from_dump(claims, dump, gt_path = the driver's GT, paths.GT_ROOT/<item>/gt.json) and a1_counts_drop(claims, that GT); PV_V5_PREREG / PV_GT_ROOT / PV_PVSCORE_DIR are set by the driver to the copies it uses
driver_rules.error: an exception in claims_score -> pending scorer_error (never 0)
driver_rules.layer: the cell's layer is v5; the layout_r2 text layer is not run for it

registered_sources.note: shas at registration; the claims may still change after v5 blind round 1 triage: every run records the shas it used, and the package pins them in FROZEN_5_1.json (vendored text-v5)
